sn_bom_service_definition.description:
The Certificate Request Service enables retail customers and trading partners to request official food safety, quality, and analytical certificates for Mondelez products. This includes FSSC 22000, IFS, and BRCGS food safety certifications, as well as Certificates of Analysis (CoA) and Certificates of Conformance (CoC) covering microbiological, physical, and chemical test results.
Requests are submitted through the Mondelez Customer Enquiry Portal and processed automatically. The system identifies the relevant manufacturing site based on the product SKU, GTIN, or batch code provided, retrieves the current certificate from the Mondelez document repository, and delivers it directly to the requester. Where a request cannot be fulfilled automatically — for example, where product identifiers are incomplete or where multiple sites are involved — the case is routed to BU/CU Quality for manual handling.
All requests are tracked against a defined service level agreement. The portal provides full visibility of case status at every stage, from submission through to delivery. Requesters are notified automatically when their certificate has been issued and have the option to raise a follow-up if the response does not meet their needs.
Service Scope: - FSSC 22000, IFS, BRCGS food safety and quality certifications - Certificates of Analysis (microbiological, physical, chemical) - Certificates of Conformance (analytical laboratory, thermal process) - Halal and Kosher certification (where applicable) - Environment, Health and Safety certificates
Out of Scope: - Product specifications and technical data sheets (covered by a separate service) - Export and import certificates such as health certificates and LTSDs - Regulatory compliance declarations for packaging materials
